features.text: Select multiple songs in a playlist at once, to add them to the queue, a playlist or edit their tags together
Browse your music by folder in a new Folders library tab, which you can turn on in Appearance settings
Sort your playlists list by name
Sort your albums list randomly, to help you pick something to listen to
Reverse a playlist's sort order from the sort menu
Open audio files from your file manager, downloads or messages in S2 to play them, and pick S2 as your default music app

On Android 14 and later, a new USB DAC direct output option in Playback settings sends songs to a USB DAC at their own sample rate as 16-bit audio, without resampling, mixing in other sounds, or applying the equaliser and ReplayGain
Songs you play from Jellyfin, Emby or Plex now show in your server's now playing and count towards its play history, so scrobbling plugins can pick them up. You can turn this off in Media settings
Added a fast scrollbar to the Playlists tab, matching the other library tabs
Sort your genres list by song count
Export a playlist to an m3u file from the playlist menu
Playlists imported from an .m3u file now stay in sync with that file when you add, remove or reorder songs

improvements.text: More local album art filenames are now recognised, including albumart.jpg, front.jpg and artwork.jpg

Rebuilt the home screen widgets. They resize freely, show bigger artwork on larger sizes, follow your system theme and wallpaper colours, and add previous, shuffle and repeat buttons. The background opacity is adjustable in Settings, Widgets
The playback notification now uses Android's standard media controls, with shuffle and repeat buttons, and Android Auto, headsets and the lock screen follow what's playing more closely

fixes.text: The home screen's "Albums released this year" now shows up to 100 albums instead of stopping at 20
ReplayGain now works for songs found by the media scanner, after a rescan
Fixed audio glitches and possible crashes when playing 24-bit files with the equaliser or ReplayGain on
Fixed your phone's own sound effects staying attached to the app after switching to Chromecast
Songs added to the queue while shuffle is on now play in the order you picked them, and Play Next keeps its place when you turn shuffle off
Swiping over the lyrics view no longer accidentally skips to the next or previous song, and lyrics now scroll back to the top when the song changes
ReplayGain now sets each song's volume before it starts playing, so the level no longer jumps a moment into the song, including when a FLAC song follows an MP3 or the other way round
Tracks on multi-disc albums now play in the right order when using the Android media scanner
Fixed the progress bar on the lock screen, in the car and on other media controls jumping back after turning shuffle on or off
Seeking while a song is still loading now starts it from the spot you picked, instead of the seek being lost
Skipping quickly through several songs no longer briefly plays one you already skipped past
Removing the playing song from the queue now moves playback on to the next song, and a song removed from the queue no longer plays anyway when the current one ends
The resume position after the app is closed is now correct after seeking back or restarting a track
Fixed signing in to and playing music from Jellyfin 12 servers
Fixed songs from Jellyfin, Emby and Plex failing to play
Fixed Jellyfin and Emby songs that the server converts for your phone, such as WMA or AIFF files, failing to play
Pausing now releases audio focus, so other apps can play sound again without you closing S2 first
The notification and progress bar now show the new song right away when one track ends and the next starts, instead of briefly showing the old one

Song, album and artist artwork now updates after you change it, whether it's embedded in the file, a cover image in the folder or on your Jellyfin or Emby server, once the library rescans or syncs. Newly added local artwork now also replaces artwork that was previously shown from S2's online artwork lookup
Album art from a cover image in the song's folder, such as cover.jpg or folder.jpg, now shows on Android 13 and later when using the Android media scanner
S2 now appears as a single device on your Jellyfin, Emby and Plex servers, instead of a new device each time the app starts
Recently Added no longer fills up with every Jellyfin, Emby and Plex song after each sync
Editing a song's tags now updates its title, artist and album everywhere it's already showing, including the queue, now playing, mini player and notification, without interrupting playback
The seekbar now follows a seek made from another Chromecast sender even while playback is paused

When none of the next songs will load, playback now stops on the last one tried instead of jumping back to where it started and looking like it is still playing. Previous on Chromecast restarts the song when its position is unknown
Offline downloads from Jellyfin/Emby no longer fail when the server admin disables downloading
A song no longer loses its selection mark in the Songs list when it starts or stops playing
Fixed a crash when fast-scrolling to the bottom of the Songs list
The back button now exits multi-select mode on the Songs, Albums and Artists tabs instead of leaving the library
